media.alt_text: (Blue graphic with white text) IMPLEMENTING THE CREDIBLE FEAR AND ASYLUM PROCESSING INTERIM FINAL RULE: Last month, DHS and the Department of Justice began implementing a rule ensuring that those subject to expedited removal who are eligible for asylum are granted relief quickly, and those who are not are promptly removed. The new rule helps reduce existing immigration court backlogs and shortens the process to several months.

tweets.text: Through a new process, DHS and the @DeptofJustice are expediting the processing of asylum claims made by noncitizens subject to expedited removal - ensuring those who are eligible for asylum are granted relief quickly, and those who are not are promptly removed. #SummitAmericas
